premise: After the long night the solar panel tilts to the first sunlight, the greenhouse lights blink on, the seedling stretches and the flower turns to its lamp: everything green wakes up, one by one.
inspiration: 'The House That Jack Built', the chain rhyme, turned: each thing that wakes wakes the next.
lesson: Every helper passes the good along.

en-US.title: Good Morning, Green Things
en-US.text: [softly] For two whole weeks the base had been dark and cold. {all:face sleeping} Everything was waiting. {canvas:daybreak} Then, over the far ridge, a stripe of white sunlight came sweeping across the plain. The {solar-panel:enter} solar panel felt it first. {solar-panel:live} Slowly, it tilted its sixteen blue cells up to the Sun. {sfx:hum} Power hummed down the cables to the {greenhouse:enter} greenhouse, all the way across the plain. {greenhouse:live} {sfx:clicks} Click, click, click! Its grow lights blinked on, and every plant inside perked up. {solar-panel:glow 0.5} In its little dome, the {seedling:enter} seedling had been waiting all night long. {seedling:live} It stretched, and opened a brand-new leaf. {greenhouse:sparkle} And in its sealed box, the orange {flower:enter} flower had been waiting too. {flower:live} It turned its bloom up toward its lamp. {seedling:pulse} [happily] {all:face happy} One by one, everything green was {all:hop} awake. {flower:glow 0.5} [warmly] Good morning, Moon.

es-ES.title: Buenos días, cosas verdes
es-ES.text: [softly] Durante dos semanas enteras la base había estado oscura y fría. {all:face sleeping} Todo esperaba. {canvas:daybreak} Entonces, por encima de las montañas, una franja de luz blanca recorrió la llanura. El {solar-panel:enter} panel solar la notó primero. {solar-panel:live} Despacio, inclinó sus dieciséis celdas azules hacia el Sol. {sfx:hum} La energía zumbó por los cables hasta el {greenhouse:enter} invernadero, al otro lado de la llanura. {greenhouse:live} {sfx:clicks} ¡Clic, clic, clic! Se encendieron sus luces, y todas las plantas de dentro se animaron. {solar-panel:glow 0.5} En su cúpula, el {seedling:enter} brote había esperado toda la noche. {seedling:live} Se estiró y abrió una hoja nuevecita. {greenhouse:sparkle} Y en su caja sellada, la {flower:enter} flor naranja también esperaba. {flower:live} Giró su flor hacia la lámpara. {seedling:pulse} [happily] {all:face happy} Una a una, todas las cosas verdes se {all:hop} despertaron. {flower:glow 0.5} [warmly] Buenos días, Luna.

hum.prompt: a small electric motor humming softly as a solar panel tilts, smooth and slow

clicks.prompt: three soft quick clicks of lamps switching on, one after another
